the accuracy is reported as a property of the monitor.

We make the untrusted policy family the controlled axis: we fit a monitor on family A's transcripts, apply it to family B
decompose the cross-family AUROC into how obvious each family's sabotage is, how capable each monitor is
the residual own-family advantage after both are removed: the interaction.
On code-backdoor transcripts the interaction is positive
survives the dominant confounds: +0.172 (95% CI [+0.158, +0.185]) on four open-weight families on a strict leak-free basis, holding across a

claims.text: For the past year, we at the AI Futures Project have been sinking most of our time into our next big scenario.
It’s called AI 2040: Plan A.
It’s called Plan A because it’s a recommendation, not a prediction.
It’s what we think should happen, not what will happen, though we think it’s plausible enough to aim for.
It’s called AI 2040 because in it, they delay the creation of superintelligence to 2040.
It would have happened much sooner (in 2030, to be precise) if not for decisive action on the part of the US and Chinese governments.
As with AI 2027, summaries don’t really do it justice, since the whole point was to be detailed and comprehensive
work things out step by step rather than rely on high-level abstractions like doom or utopia.
Read the scenario at ai-2040.com.
You can listen to it on audio, or view it on mobile
the experience is significantly better on a normal computer.
Well, first we are going to respond to comments
otherwise engage with whatever conversation, responses, critiques, etc. that AI 2040: Plan A sparks.
In general our mission is to help make AGI go well, and now we’ve tried out both forecasting and planning.
